1.text: Tha words of Nehemiah tha son of Hachaliah. N it happened in tha month Chisleu, in tha twentieth year, as I was in Shushan tha palace,
Dat Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he N certain men of Judah; N I asked ’em concerning tha Jews dat had escaped, which were left of tha captivity, N concerning Jerusalem.
N dey said 2 me, tha remnant dat r left of tha captivity there in tha province r in great affliction N reproach: tha wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, N tha gates of it r burned wit fire.
N it happened, when I heard dese words, dat I sat down N wept, N mourned certain days, N fasted, N prayed before tha God of heaven,
N said, I beg u, O LORD God of heaven, tha great N terrible God, dat keeps covenant N mercy 4 ’em dat love him N observe his commandments:

Let thine ear now be attentive, N ur eyes open, dat u may hear tha prayer of ur servant, which I pray before u now, day N night, 4 tha children of Israel ur servants, N confess tha sins of tha children of Israel, which we have sinned against u: both I N my father’s house have sinned.
We have dealt very corruptly against u, N have not kept tha commandments, nor tha statutes, nor tha judgments, which u commandedst ur servant Moses.
Remember, I beg u, tha word dat u commandedst ur servant Moses, sayin, If y’all transgress, I will scatter u abroad among tha nations:

But if y’all turn 2 me, N keep my commandments, N do ’em; though there were of u cast out 2 tha uttermost part of tha heaven, yet will I gather ’em from thence, N will bring ’em 2 tha place dat I have chosen 2 set my name there.
Now dese r ur servants N ur people, whom u have redeemed by ur great power, N by ur strong hand.

O Lord, I beg u, let now thine ear be attentive 2 tha prayer of ur servant, N 2 tha prayer of ur servants, who desire 2 fear ur name: N prosper, I pray u, ur servant dis day, N grant him mercy in tha sight of dis man. 4 I was tha king’s cupbearer.

2.text: N it happened in tha month Nisan, in tha twentieth year of Artaxerxes tha king, dat wine was before him: N I took up tha wine, N gave it 2 tha king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
So tha king said 2 me, Why is ur countenance sad, seein u r not sick? dis is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
N said 2 tha king, Let tha king live 4 ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when tha city, tha place of my fathers’ sepulchres, lies waste, N tha gates of it r consumed wit fire?
Then tha king said 2 me, 4 what do u make request? So I prayed 2 tha God of heaven.
N I said 2 tha king, If it please tha king, N if ur servant have found favour in ur sight, dat u would send me 2 Judah, 2 tha city of my fathers’ sepulchres, dat I may build it.
N tha king said 2 me, (tha queen also sittin by him,) 4 how long shall ur journey be? N when will u return? So it pleased tha king 2 send me; N I set him a time.
Moreover I said 2 tha king, If it please tha king, let letters be given me 2 tha governors beyond tha river, dat dey may convey me over till I come in2 Judah;

N a letter 2 Asaph tha keeper of tha king’s forest, dat he may give me timber 2 make beams 4 tha gates of tha palace which appertained 2 tha house, N 4 tha wall of tha city, N 4 tha house dat I shall enter in2. N tha king granted me, according 2 tha good hand of my God upon me.
Then I came 2 tha governors beyond tha river, N gave ’em tha king’s letters. Now tha king had sent captains of tha army N horsemen wit me.
When Sanballat tha Horonite, N Tobiah tha servant, tha Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved ’em exceedingly dat there was come a man 2 seek tha welfare of tha children of Israel.
So I came 2 Jerusalem, N was there three days.
N I arose in tha night, I N some few men wit me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart 2 do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast wit me, save tha beast dat I rode upon.
N I went out by night by tha gate of tha valley, even before tha dragon well, N 2 tha dung port, N viewed tha walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, N tha gates of it were consumed wit fire.
Then I went on 2 tha gate of tha fountain, N 2 tha king’s pool: but there was no place 4 tha beast dat was under me 2 pass.
Then went I up in tha night by tha brook, N viewed tha wall, N turned back, N entered by tha gate of tha valley, N so returned.
N tha rulers knew not where I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it 2 tha Jews, nor 2 tha priests, nor 2 tha nobles, nor 2 tha rulers, nor 2 tha rest dat did tha work.
Then said I 2 ’em, y’all see tha distress dat we r in, how Jerusalem lies waste, N tha gates of it r burned wit fire: come, N let us build up tha wall of Jerusalem, dat we be no more a reproach.
Then I told ’em of tha hand of my God which was good upon me; as also tha king’s words dat he had spoken 2 me. N dey said, Let us rise up N build. So dey strengthened their hands 4 dis good work.

But when Sanballat tha Horonite, N Tobiah tha servant, tha Ammonite, N Geshem tha Arabian, heard it, dey laughed us 2 scorn, N despised us, N said, What is dis thing dat y’all do? will y’all rebel against tha king?
Then answered I ’em, N said 2 ’em, tha God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise N build: but y’all have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

3.text: Then Eliashib tha high priest rose up wit his brothers tha priests, N dey builded tha sheep gate; dey sanctified it, N set up tha doors of it; even 2 tha tower of Meah dey sanctified it, 2 tha tower of Hananeel.
N next 2 him builded tha men of Jericho. N next 2 ’em builded Zaccur tha son of Imri.
But tha fish gate did tha sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid tha beams of it, N set up tha doors of it, tha locks of it, N tha bars of it.
N next 2 ’em repaired Meremoth tha son of Urijah, tha son of Koz. N next 2 ’em repaired Meshullam tha son of Berechiah, tha son of Meshezabeel. N next 2 ’em repaired Zadok tha son of Baana.
N next 2 ’em tha Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks 2 tha work of their Lord.
Moreover tha old gate repaired Jehoiada tha son of Paseah, N Meshullam tha son of Besodeiah; dey laid tha beams of it, N set up tha doors of it, N tha locks of it, N tha bars of it.
N next 2 ’em repaired Melatiah tha Gibeonite, N Jadon tha Meronothite, tha men of Gibeon, N of Mizpah, 2 tha throne of tha governor on dis side tha river.
Next 2 him repaired Uzziel tha son of Harhaiah, of tha goldsmiths. Next 2 him also repaired Hananiah tha son of one of tha apothecaries, N dey fortified Jerusalem 2 tha broad wall.
N next 2 ’em repaired Rephaiah tha son of Hur, tha ruler of tha half part of Jerusalem.
N next 2 ’em repaired Jedaiah tha son of Harumaph, even over against his house. N next 2 him repaired Hattush tha son of Hashabniah.
Malchijah tha son of Harim, N Hashub tha son of Pahath-moab, repaired tha other piece, N tha tower of tha furnaces.
N next 2 him repaired Shallum tha son of Halohesh, tha ruler of tha half part of Jerusalem, he N his daughters.
Tha valley gate repaired Hanun, N tha inhabitants of Zanoah; dey built it, N set up tha doors of it, tha locks of it, N tha bars of it, N a thousand cubits on tha wall 2 tha dung gate.
But tha dung gate repaired Malchiah tha son of Rechab, tha ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he built it, N set up tha doors of it, tha locks of it, N tha bars of it.

But tha gate of tha fountain repaired Shallun tha son of Col-hozeh, tha ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, N covered it, N set up tha doors of it, tha locks of it, N tha bars of it, N tha wall of tha pool of Siloah by tha king’s garden, N 2 tha stairs dat go down from tha city of David.
After him repaired Nehemiah tha son of Azbuk, tha ruler of tha half part of Beth-zur, 2 tha place over against tha sepulchres of David, N 2 tha pool dat was made, N 2 tha house of tha mighty.
After him repaired tha Levites, Rehum tha son of Bani. Next 2 him repaired Hashabiah, tha ruler of tha half part of Keilah, in his part.
After him repaired their brothers, Bavai tha son of Henadad, tha ruler of tha half part of Keilah.
N next 2 him repaired Ezer tha son of Jeshua, tha ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against tha goin up 2 tha armoury at tha turnin of tha wall.
After him Baruch tha son of Zabbai earnestly repaired tha other piece, from tha turnin of tha wall 2 tha door of tha house of Eliashib tha high priest.
After him repaired Meremoth tha son of Urijah tha son of Koz another piece, from tha door of tha house of Eliashib even 2 tha end of tha house of Eliashib.
N after him repaired tha priests, tha men of tha plain.
After him repaired Benjamin N Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah tha son of Maaseiah tha son of Ananiah by his house.
After him repaired Binnui tha son of Henadad another piece, from tha house of Azariah 2 tha turnin of tha wall, even 2 tha corner.
Palal tha son of Uzai, over against tha turnin of tha wall, N tha tower which lies out from tha king’s high house, dat was by tha court of tha prison. After him Pedaiah tha son of Parosh.
Moreover tha Nethinims lived in Ophel, 2 tha place over against tha water gate toward tha east, N tha tower dat lies out.
After ’em tha Tekoites repaired another piece, over against tha great tower dat lies out, even 2 tha wall of Ophel.
From above tha horse gate repaired tha priests, every one over against his house.
After ’em repaired Zadok tha son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah tha son of Shechaniah, tha keeper of tha east gate.
After him repaired Hananiah tha son of Shelemiah, N Hanun tha sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam tha son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
After him repaired Malchiah tha goldsmith’s son 2 tha place of tha Nethinims, N of tha merchants, over against tha gate Miphkad, N 2 tha goin up of tha corner.
N between tha goin up of tha corner 2 tha sheep gate repaired tha goldsmiths N tha merchants.

4.text: But it happened, dat when Sanballat heard dat we builded tha wall, he was angry, N took great indignation, N mocked tha Jews.

N he spoke before his brothers N tha army of Samaria, N said, What do dese feeble Jews? will dey fortify themselves? will dey sacrifice? will dey make an end in a day? will dey revive tha stones out of tha heaps of tha rubbish which r burned?
Now Tobiah tha Ammonite was by him, N he said, Even dat which dey build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
Hear, O our God; 4 we r despised: N turn their reproach upon their own head, N give ’em 4 a prey in tha land of captivity:
N cover not their iniquity, N don’t let their sin be blotted out from before u: 4 dey have provoked u 2 anger before tha builders.
So built we tha wall; N all tha wall was joined together 2 tha half of it: 4 tha people had a mind 2 work.

But it happened, dat when Sanballat, N Tobiah, N tha Arabians, N tha Ammonites, N tha Ashdodites, heard dat tha walls of Jerusalem were made up, N dat tha breaches began 2 be stopped, then dey were very angry,
N conspired all of ’em together 2 come N 2 fight against Jerusalem, N 2 hinder it.
Nevertheless we made our prayer 2 our God, N set a watch against ’em day N night, because of ’em.
N Judah said, tha strength of tha bearers of burdens is decayed, N there is much rubbish; so dat we r not able 2 build tha wall.
N our adversaries said, dey shall not know, neither see, till we come in tha midst among ’em, N kill ’em, N cause tha work 2 cease.
N it happened, dat when tha Jews which lived by ’em came, dey said 2 us ten times, From all places from where y’all shall return 2 us dey will be upon u.
Therefore set I in tha lower places behind tha wall, N on tha higher places, I even set tha people after their families wit their swords, their spears, N their bows.

N I looked, N rose up, N said 2 tha nobles, N 2 tha rulers, N 2 tha rest of tha people, don’t be y’all afraid of ’em: remember tha Lord, which is great N terrible, N fight 4 ur brothers, ur sons, N ur daughters, ur wives, N ur houses.
N it happened, when our opps heard dat it was known 2 us, N God had brought their counsel 2 nothing, dat we returned all of us 2 tha wall, every one 2 his work.

N it happened from dat time forth, dat tha half of my servants wrought in tha work, N tha other half of ’em held both tha spears, tha shields, N tha bows, N tha habergeons; N tha rulers were behind all tha house of Judah.
Dey which builded on tha wall, N dey dat bare burdens, wit dose dat laded, every one wit one of his hands wrought in tha work, N wit tha other hand held a weapon.
4 tha builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, N so builded. N he dat sounded tha trumpet was by me.
N I said 2 tha nobles, N 2 tha rulers, N 2 tha rest of tha people, tha work is great N large, N we r separated upon tha wall, one far from another.
In what place therefore y’all hear tha sound of tha trumpet, resort y’all there 2 us: our God shall fight 4 us.
So we laboured in tha work: N half of ’em held tha spears from tha risin of tha morning till tha stars appeared.
Likewise at tha same time said I 2 tha people, Let every one wit his servant lodge within Jerusalem, dat in tha night dey may be a guard 2 us, N labour on tha day.
So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor tha men of tha guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving dat every one put ’em off 4 washing.

5.text: N there was a great cry of tha people N of their wives against their brothers tha Jews.
4 there were dat said, We, our sons, N our daughters, r many: therefore we take up corn 4 ’em, dat we may eat, N live.
Some also there were dat said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, N houses, dat we might buy corn, because of tha dearth.
There were also dat said, We have borrowed money 4 tha king’s tribute, N dat upon our lands N vineyards.

Yet now our flesh is as tha flesh of our brothers, our children as their children: N, look, we bring in2 bondage our sons N our daughters 2 be servants, N some of our daughters r brought 2 bondage already: neither is it in our power 2 redeem ’em; 4 other men have our lands N vineyards.
N I was very angry when I heard their cry N dese words.
Then I consulted wit myself, N I rebuked tha nobles, N tha rulers, N said 2 ’em, y’all exact usury, every one of his brother. N I set a great assembly against ’em.

N I said 2 ’em, We after our ability have redeemed our brothers tha Jews, which were sold 2 tha heathen; N will y’all even sell ur brothers? or shall dey be sold 2 us? Then held dey their peace, N found nothing 2 answer.
Also I said, It is not good dat y’all do: ought y’all not 2 walk in tha fear of our God because of tha reproach of tha heathen our opps?
I likewise, N my brothers, N my servants, might exact of ’em money N corn: I pray u, let us leave off dis usury.

Restore, I pray u, 2 ’em, even dis day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, N their houses, also tha hundredth part of tha money, N of tha corn, tha wine, N tha oil, dat y’all exact of ’em.
Then said dey, We will restore ’em, N will require nothing of ’em; so will we do as u sayest. Then I called tha priests, N took an oath of ’em, dat dey should do according 2 dis promise.

Also I shook my lap, N said, So God shake out every man from his house, N from his labour, dat performeth not dis promise, even like dis be he shaken out, N emptied. N all tha congregation said, Amen, N praised tha LORD. N tha people did according 2 dis promise.

Moreover from tha time dat I was appointed 2 be their governor in tha land of Judah, from tha twentieth year even 2 tha two N thirtieth year of Artaxerxes tha king, dat is, twelve years, I N my brothers have not eaten tha bread of tha governor.

But tha former governors dat had been before me were chargeable 2 tha people, N had taken of ’em bread N wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yeah, even their servants bare rule over tha people: but so did not I, because of tha fear of God.
Yeah, also I continued in tha work of dis wall, neither bought we any land: N all my servants were gathered there 2 tha work.
Moreover there were at my table an hundred N fifty of tha Jews N rulers, beside dose dat came 2 us from among tha heathen dat r about us.

Now dat which was prepared 4 me daily was one ox N six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared 4 me, N once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet 4 all dis required not I tha bread of tha governor, because tha bondage was heavy upon dis people.
Think upon me, my God, 4 good, according 2 all dat I have done 4 dis people.

6.text: Now it happened, when Sanballat, N Tobiah, N Geshem tha Arabian, N tha rest of our opps, heard dat I had builded tha wall, N dat there was no breach left in it; (though at dat time I had not set up tha doors upon tha gates;)
Dat Sanballat N Geshem sent 2 me, sayin, Come, let us meet together in some one of tha villages in tha plain of Ono. But dey thought 2 do me mischief.
N I sent messengers 2 ’em, sayin, I am doin a great work, so dat I cannot come down: why should tha work cease, whilst I leave it, N come down 2 u?
Yet dey sent 2 me four times after dis sort; N I answered ’em after tha same manner.
Then sent Sanballat his servant 2 me in like manner tha fifth time wit an open letter in his hand;
In which was written, It is reported among tha heathen, N Gashmu says it, dat u N tha Jews think 2 rebel: 4 which cause u build tha wall, dat u may be their king, according 2 dese words.

N u have also appointed prophets 2 preach of u at Jerusalem, sayin, There is a king in Judah: N now shall it be reported 2 tha king according 2 dese words. Come now therefore, N let us take counsel together.
Then I sent 2 him, sayin, There r no such things done as u sayest, but u feignest ’em out of ur own heart.
4 dey all made us afraid, sayin, Their hands shall be weakened from tha work, dat it don’t be done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.

Afterward I came 2 tha house of Shemaiah tha son of Delaiah tha son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; N he said, Let us meet together in tha house of God, within tha temple, N let us shut tha doors of tha temple: 4 dey will come 2 kill u; yeah, in tha night will dey come 2 kill u.
N I said, Should such a man as I flee? N who is there, dat, bein as I am, would go in2 tha temple 2 save his life? I will not go in.
N, look, I perceived dat God had not sent him; but dat he pronounced dis prophecy against me: 4 Tobiah N Sanballat had hired him.
Therefore was he hired, dat I should be afraid, N do so, N sin, N dat dey might have matter 4 an evil report, dat dey might reproach me.
My God, think u upon Tobiah N Sanballat according 2 dese their works, N on tha prophetess Noadiah, N tha rest of tha prophets, dat would have put me in fear.
So tha wall was finished in tha twenty N fifth day of tha month Elul, in fifty N two days.
N it happened, dat when all our opps heard of it, N all tha heathen dat were about us saw dese things, dey were much cast down in their own eyes: 4 dey perceived dat dis work was wrought of our God.
Moreover in dose days tha nobles of Judah sent many letters 2 Tobiah, N tha letters of Tobiah came 2 ’em.
4 there were many in Judah sworn 2 him, because he was tha son in law of Shechaniah tha son of Arah; N his son Johanan had taken tha daughter of Meshullam tha son of Berechiah.
Also dey reported his good deeds before me, N uttered my words 2 him. N Tobiah sent letters 2 put me in fear.

7.text: Now it happened, when tha wall was built, N I had set up tha doors, N tha porters N tha singers N tha Levites were appointed,
Dat I gave my brother Hanani, N Hananiah tha ruler of tha palace, charge over Jerusalem: 4 he was a faithful man, N feared God above many.

N I said 2 ’em, don’t let tha gates of Jerusalem be opened until tha sun be hot; N while dey stand by, let ’em shut tha doors, N bar ’em: N appoint watches of tha inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, N every one 2 be over against his house.
Now tha city was large N great: but tha people were few in it, N tha houses were not builded.

N my God put in2 mine heart 2 gather together tha nobles, N tha rulers, N tha people, dat dey might be reckoned by genealogy. N I found a register of tha genealogy of ’em which came up at tha first, N found written in it,

Dese r tha children of tha province, dat went up out of tha captivity, of dose dat had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar tha king of Babylon had carried away, N came again 2 Jerusalem N 2 Judah, every one 2 his city;
Who came wit Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. tha number, I say, of tha men of tha people of Israel was dis;
Tha children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy N two.
Tha children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy N two.
Tha children of Arah, six hundred fifty N two.
Tha children of Pahath-moab, of tha children of Jeshua N Joab, two thousand N eight hundred N eighteen.
Tha children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty N four.
Tha children of Zattu, eight hundred forty N five.
Tha children of Zaccai, seven hundred N threescore.
Tha children of Binnui, six hundred forty N eight.
Tha children of Bebai, six hundred twenty N eight.
Tha children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty N two.
Tha children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore N seven.
Tha children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore N seven.
Tha children of Adin, six hundred fifty N five.
Tha children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety N eight.
Tha children of Hashum, three hundred twenty N eight.
Tha children of Bezai, three hundred twenty N four.
Tha children of Hariph, an hundred N twelve.
Tha children of Gibeon, ninety N five.
Tha men of Beth-lehem N Netophah, an hundred fourscore N eight.
Tha men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty N eight.
Tha men of Beth-azmaveth, forty N two.
Tha men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, N Beeroth, seven hundred forty N three.
Tha men of Ramah N Geba, six hundred twenty N one.
Tha men of Michmas, an hundred N twenty N two.
Tha men of Beth-el N Ai, an hundred twenty N three.
Tha men of tha other Nebo, fifty N two.
Tha children of tha other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty N four.
Tha children of Harim, three hundred N twenty.
Tha children of Jericho, three hundred forty N five.
Tha children of Lod, Hadid, N Ono, seven hundred twenty N one.
Tha children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred N thirty.
Tha priests: tha children of Jedaiah, of tha house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy N three.
Tha children of Immer, a thousand fifty N two.
Tha children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty N seven.
Tha children of Harim, a thousand N seventeen.
Tha Levites: tha children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, N of tha children of Hodevah, seventy N four.
Tha singers: tha children of Asaph, an hundred forty N eight.
Tha porters: tha children of Shallum, tha children of Ater, tha children of Talmon, tha children of Akkub, tha children of Hatita, tha children of Shobai, an hundred thirty N eight.
Tha Nethinims: tha children of Ziha, tha children of Hashupha, tha children of Tabbaoth,
Tha children of Keros, tha children of Sia, tha children of Padon,
Tha children of Lebana, tha children of Hagaba, tha children of Shalmai,
Tha children of Hanan, tha children of Giddel, tha children of Gahar,
Tha children of Reaiah, tha children of Rezin, tha children of Nekoda,
Tha children of Gazzam, tha children of Uzza, tha children of Phaseah,
Tha children of Besai, tha children of Meunim, tha children of Nephishesim,
Tha children of Bakbuk, tha children of Hakupha, tha children of Harhur,
Tha children of Bazlith, tha children of Mehida, tha children of Harsha,
Tha children of Barkos, tha children of Sisera, tha children of Tamah,
Tha children of Neziah, tha children of Hatipha.
Tha children of Solomon’s servants: tha children of Sotai, tha children of Sophereth, tha children of Perida,
Tha children of Jaala, tha children of Darkon, tha children of Giddel,
Tha children of Shephatiah, tha children of Hattil, tha children of Pochereth of Zebaim, tha children of Amon.
All tha Nethinims, N tha children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety N two.
N dese were dey which went up also from Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, N Immer: but dey could not show their father’s house, nor their seed, whether dey were of Israel.
Tha children of Delaiah, tha children of Tobiah, tha children of Nekoda, six hundred forty N two.
N of tha priests: tha children of Habaiah, tha children of Koz, tha children of Barzillai, which took one of tha daughters of Barzillai tha Gileadite 2 wife, N was called after their name.
Dese sought their register among dose dat were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were dey, as polluted, put from tha priesthood.
N tha Tirshatha said 2 ’em, dat dey should not eat of tha most holy things, till there stood up a priest wit Urim N Thummim.
Tha whole congregation together was forty N two thousand three hundred N threescore,
Beside their manservants N their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty N seven: N dey had two hundred forty N five singin men N singin women.
Their horses, seven hundred thirty N six: their mules, two hundred forty N five:
Their camels, four hundred thirty N five: six thousand seven hundred N twenty asses.
N some of tha chief of tha fathers gave 2 tha work. tha Tirshatha gave 2 tha treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred N thirty priests’ garments.
N some of tha chief of tha fathers gave 2 tha treasure of tha work twenty thousand drams of gold, N two thousand N two hundred pound of silver.
N dat which tha rest of tha people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, N two thousand pound of silver, N threescore N seven priests’ garments.

So tha priests, N tha Levites, N tha porters, N tha singers, N some of tha people, N tha Nethinims, N all Israel, lived in their citiez; N when tha seventh month came, tha children of Israel were in their citiez.

8.text: N all tha people gathered themselves together as one man in2 tha street dat was before tha water gate; N dey spoke 2 Ezra tha scribe 2 bring tha book of tha law of Moses, which tha LORD had commanded 2 Israel.
N Ezra tha priest brought tha law before tha congregation both of men N women, N all dat could hear wit understanding, upon tha first day of tha seventh month.

N he read in it before tha street dat was before tha water gate from tha morning until midday, before tha men N tha women, N dose dat could understand; N tha ears of all tha people were attentive 2 tha book of tha law.

N Ezra tha scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which dey had made 4 tha purpose; N beside him stood Mattithiah, N Shema, N Anaiah, N Urijah, N Hilkiah, N Maaseiah, on his right hand; N on his left hand, Pedaiah, N Mishael, N Malchiah, N Hashum, N Hashbadana, Zechariah, N Meshullam.

u, even u, art LORD alone; u have made heaven, tha heaven of heavenz, wit all their host, tha earth, N all things dat r in it, tha seas, N all dat is in it, N u preserve ’em all; N tha host of heaven worships u.

N did see tha affliction of our fathers in Egypt, N heard their cry by tha Red sea;
N shewedst signs N wonders upon Pharaoh, N on all his servants, N on all tha people of his land: 4 u knew dat dey dealt proudly against ’em. So did u get u a name, as it is dis day.
N u did divide tha sea before ’em, so dat dey went through tha midst of tha sea on tha dry land; N their persecutors u threwest in2 tha deeps, as a stone in2 tha mighty waterz.
Moreover u leddest ’em in tha day by a cloudy pillar; N in tha night by a pillar of fire, 2 give ’em light in tha way in which dey should go.

N made known 2 ’em ur holy sabbath, N commandedst ’em precepts, statutes, N laws, by tha hand of Moses ur servant:
N gave ’em bread from heaven 4 their hunger, N brought forth water 4 ’em out of tha rock 4 their thirst, N promisedst ’em dat dey should go in 2 possess tha land which u had sworn 2 give ’em.
But dey N our fathers dealt proudly, N hardened their necks, N listened not 2 ur commandments,

N refused 2 obey, neither were mindful of ur wonders dat u did among ’em; but hardened their necks, N in their rebellion appointed a captain 2 return 2 their bondage: but u r a God ready 2 pardon, gracious N merciful, slow 2 anger, N of great kindness, N forsookest ’em not.
Yeah, when dey had made ’em a molten calf, N said, dis is ur God dat brought u up out of Egypt, N had wrought great provocations;

Yet u in ur manifold mercies forsookest ’em not in tha wilderness: tha pillar of tha cloud departed not from ’em by day, 2 lead ’em in tha way; neither tha pillar of fire by night, 2 show ’em light, N tha way in which dey should go.

So tha children went in N possessed tha land, N u subduedst before ’em tha inhabitants of tha land, tha Canaanites, N gave ’em in2 their hands, wit their kings, N tha people of tha land, dat dey might do wit ’em as dey would.

N dey took strong citiez, N a fat land, N possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, N oliveyards, N fruit trees in abundance: so dey did eat, N were filled, N became fat, N delighted themselves in ur great goodness.
Nevertheless dey were disobedient, N rebelled against u, N cast ur law behind their backs, N killed ur prophets which testified against ’em 2 turn ’em 2 u, N dey wrought great provocations.

Therefore u deliveredst ’em in2 tha hand of their opps, who vexed ’em: N in tha time of their trouble, when dey cried 2 u, u heard ’em from heaven; N according 2 ur manifold mercies u gave ’em saviours, who saved ’em out of tha hand of their opps.

N testifiedst against ’em, dat u might bring ’em again 2 ur law: yet dey dealt proudly, N listened not 2 ur commandments, but sinned against ur judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in ’em;) N withdrew tha shoulder, N hardened their neck, N would not hear.

Now therefore, our God, tha great, tha mighty, N tha terrible God, who keep covenant N mercy, don’t let all tha trouble seem little before u, dat has come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, N on our priests, N on our prophets, N on our fathers, N on all ur people, since tha time of tha kings of Assyria 2 dis day.
But u r just in all dat is brought upon us; 4 u have done right, but we have done wickedly:

13.text: On dat day dey read in tha book of Moses in tha audience of tha people; N in it was found written, dat tha Ammonite N tha Moabite should not come in2 tha congregation of God 4 ever;

N before dis, Eliashib tha priest, havin tha oversight of tha chamber of tha house of our God, was allied 2 Tobiah:

N he had prepared 4 him a great chamber, where aforetime dey laid tha food offerings, tha frankincense, N tha vessels, N tha tithes of tha corn, tha new wine, N tha oil, which was commanded 2 be given 2 tha Levites, N tha singers, N tha porters; N tha offerings of tha priests.
But in all dis time was not I at Jerusalem: 4 in tha two N thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I 2 tha king, N after certain days obtained I leave of tha king:
N I came 2 Jerusalem, N understood of tha evil dat Eliashib did 4 Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in tha courts of tha house of God.
N it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all tha household stuff of Tobiah out of tha chamber.

Then contended I wit tha rulers, N said, Why is tha house of God forsaken? N I gathered ’em together, N set ’em in their place.

N I made treasurers over tha treasuries, Shelemiah tha priest, N Zadok tha scribe, N of tha Levites, Pedaiah: N next 2 ’em was Hanan tha son of Zaccur, tha son of Mattaniah: 4 dey were counted faithful, N their office was 2 distribute 2 their brothers.
Remember me, O my God, concerning dis, N wipe not out my good deeds dat I have done 4 tha house of my God, N 4 tha offices of it.

In dose days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on tha sabbath, N bringin in sheaves, N lading asses; as also wine, grapes, N figs, N all manner of burdens, which dey brought in2 Jerusalem on tha sabbath day: N I testified against ’em in tha day in which dey sold food.

Did not ur fathers like dis, N did not our God bring all dis evil upon us, N upon dis city? yet y’all bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning tha sabbath.

Then I testified against ’em, N said 2 ’em, Why lodge y’all about tha wall? if y’all do so again, I will lay hands on u. From dat time forth came dey no more on tha sabbath.

In dose days also saw I Jews dat had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, N of Moab:
N their children spoke half in tha speech of Ashdod, N could not speak in tha Jews’ language, but according 2 tha language of each people.

N I contended wit ’em, N cursed ’em, N struck certain of ’em, N plucked off their hair, N made ’em swear by God, sayin, y’all shall not give ur daughters 2 their sons, nor take their daughters 2 ur sons, or 4 y’all.

Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by dese things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, N God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause 2 sin.
Shall we then listen 2 u 2 do all dis great evil, 2 transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
N one of tha sons of Joiada, tha son of Eliashib tha high priest, was son in law 2 Sanballat tha Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.
Remember ’em, O my God, because dey have defiled tha priesthood, N tha covenant of tha priesthood, N of tha Levites.
Like dis cleansed I ’em from all strangers, N appointed tha wards of tha priests N tha Levites, every one in his business;
N 4 tha wood offering, at times appointed, N 4 tha firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, 4 good.
